Draw it and you'll find one circle. Do the algebra and... surprise! ⭕⭕

Find the sum of the radii of ALL circles that touch both axes and pass through (2, 1). AMC 12 / IOQM-level coordinate geometry.

Comment your answer 👇 Solution tomorrow.

✅ Last answer: C, 25/4.
Let t = xy. The expression becomes t + 2/t − 2, and x + y = 1 forces t ≤ 1/4, where t + 2/t is still decreasing. So the minimum is at t = 1/4: 1/4 + 8 − 2 = 25/4. AM-GM's 4 needs x = y = 1, which is impossible here.

✅ Last answer: B, 26.7 m.
Tilt the axes along the slope. Perpendicular: u = 10 m/s, g = 5√3, so T = 4/√3 s. Along the slope: u = 10√3, g = −5, so d = 40 − 40/3 = 80/3 ≈ 26.7 m. The flat-ground formula gives 34.6 m, which is wrong here.
